questions.answer: It very hard for one finding off campus housing, and I was very lucky to find a place to stay. You have to speak norwegian to get into any places.

questions.answer: The Norwegian nature is amazing, but the opportunities in Bergen is a bit limited.

questions.answer: They have these clubs were you have to be accepted to get in. As an exchange student it can be difficult

questions.answer: Join sammen from the beginning

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go away from bergen to see the nature

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy because of the weather you do things inside, and you eat the same things as them because of the limits in the supermarket.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Don't speak English with them, speak a norwegian/danish/swedish

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The food. There is no vegetables, and if there are they cost more than the meat, 400 grams of pig is 20 dkk, but 1 kg of carrots is 40 Dkk.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Walking in the mountains.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: You need a purpose going to Bergen. If you wanna go on exchange because you want to experience a new culture, go somewhere south. The courses suck, find some you know you are gonna like.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Save money before going to Bergen

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Beginning to exercise a lot. There is not much to do so everybody just starts going to the gym.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The lack of sunlight during the winter months
